description: Add a comment to a Google Doc, or reply to an existing comment thread by passing replyTo (a comment id from list_comments). A new comment (no replyTo) is not anchored to specific text — the Docs/Drive API cannot anchor programmatically-created comments.

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

replyTo.description: a comment id (from list_comments) to reply to; omit to start a new top-level comment

name: add_comment
title: Add a comment or reply
